metadata.name: luckout
metadata.description: Luckout: buy gift cards at the price, or pay a bounded premium for a fair chance at cashback (ADR-0015)

instructions.name: admit
docs: Admits a Checkout: every card or none, in order, each debiting its Maximum Price and locking the reserve
as the cards before it left it. `number` must be the customer's next, so a retry of an admitted
Checkout fails even after its account has closed.

instructions.name: deposit_for
docs: Moves the USDC in a customer's approved account into their own Balance, and nowhere else.

instructions.name: finish_draw
docs: Finishes the Draws of the cards waiting on `round`'s randomness, once ORAO has filled it in. Anyone may
call it; it only reads the stored value, so calling again can't change a result.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Only the program's upgrade authority can initialize it, and becomes the owner.

instructions.name: open
docs: Opens the customer's account with the Default Mode they chose. Sent with the one-time approval that
makes the Vault's authority the delegate of their USDC account.

instructions.name: propose_owner
docs: Proposes a new owner, or withdraws the proposal with `None`. Nothing changes until it accepts, so the
owner and the upgrade authority can move to a multisig later without changing the program.

instructions.name: quote_many
docs: A cart's terms, card by card, as `admit` would take them now: each Lucky card's cap and lock come from
the Free Reserve the cards before it left. A Lucky card the reserve can't cover comes back Normal; a
confirmed Lucky Amount it no longer covers is quoted as without one, so the caller sees it moved.

instructions.name: reclaim
docs: The customer takes back the full amount of a card nobody confirmed or failed within 24 hours.

instructions.name: request_again
docs: Replaces a request ORAO hasn't filled an hour after it was made: its cards move to a new request under
the next seed. A filled request can't be replaced, so this never re-rolls a Draw.

instructions.name: set_cashback_cap
docs: One card pays at most the lower of `fixed` (`None` is off) and `reserve_bps` of Free Reserve.

instructions.name: set_limits
docs: `u64::MAX` is "No limit".

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Stops only new Checkouts.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Confirms delivery of `delivered` and fails `failed`. Delivered cards' Reference Prices repay the Pay
Wallet up to the daily cap; past it they wait as Proceeds. Delivered Lucky cards share one randomness
request, made in this same instruction, after delivery is confirmed (ADR-0001, amended).

instructions.name: withdraw_proceeds
docs: Proceeds go to the owner, or to the Pay Wallet.

errors.name: BadRole
errors.msg: That key can't take this role

errors.name: NewerLayout
errors.msg: This account was written by a newer build

errors.name: WrongCheckoutNumber
errors.msg: Not the customer's next Checkout number

errors.name: NormalHasLuckyAmount
errors.msg: A Normal purchase has no Lucky Amount

errors.name: ReserveMoved
errors.msg: The Cashback Reserve moved since you confirmed; please confirm again

errors.name: ReserveTooSmall
errors.msg: Reserve too small for a Lucky Buy; use Normal

errors.name: PriceChanged
errors.msg: Price changed since you confirmed; please confirm again

errors.name: LuckyCheckoutTooSmall
errors.msg: A Lucky Checkout plays at least the smallest Lucky Checkout

errors.name: UnknownCard
errors.msg: No such card in this Checkout

errors.name: RandomnessFilled
errors.msg: The randomness has arrived: finish the Draw instead

errors.name: NothingToDraw
errors.msg: No card is waiting on this request

errors.name: TooEarlyToRequestAgain
errors.msg: A request can be replaced an hour after it was made

errors.name: TooManyRounds
errors.msg: Too many randomness requests for one Checkout

errors.name: BadCashbackCap
errors.msg: The fixed limit must be above 0, and the reserve share above 0% and at most 50%

fields.name: max_price
docs: Debited at admission: the Maximum Price, or the Reference Price for Normal.

fields.name: locked
docs: Free Reserve locked for this card: its largest Reference Discount.

fields.name: round
docs: Which of the Checkout's randomness requests draws this card.

types.name: CardOrder
docs: One card to admit, as the customer confirmed it. `mode: None` plays their Default Mode.

fields.name: max_debit
docs: The most the customer confirmed for this card; a higher Maximum Price is refused.

fields.name: lucky_amount
docs: The Lucky Amount the customer confirmed; without it, the most the reserve allows now.

types.name: CashbackCap
docs: The most Cashback one card can pay: the lower of a fixed amount (`None` is off) and a share of Free Reserve.

fields.name: customer
docs: The customer's wallet.

fields.name: payer
docs: Paid the rent, and gets it back when the Checkout closes.

fields.name: rounds
docs: Randomness requests made so far; the next request's seed uses this number.

fields.name: pending_owner
docs: Becomes the owner only when it accepts, so a typo can't hand the program to a key nobody holds.

fields.name: pay_wallet
docs: The Pay Wallet's USDC account, which `settle` repays.

fields.name: paused
docs: Stops only new Checkouts. Settling, Draws, Reclaim, deposits and withdrawals keep working.

fields.name: min_lucky_checkout
docs: A Checkout with Lucky cards plays at least this much Lucky Amount, so its margin pays for its Draw.

fields.name: proceeds
docs: Delivered cards' Reference Prices not yet repaid to the Pay Wallet (past the daily cap), held for the owner.

fields.name: lucky_settled
docs: Live Average = lucky_paid_total / lucky_amount_total, promised to be about 105.6%.

fields.name: versions
docs: Append-only. Grows by one entry with each `add_game_version`.

fields.name: wallet
docs: The customer's Privy wallet: their Deposit Address, and the key that signs for them.

fields.name: premiums_paid
docs: Running Total = cashback_received - premiums_paid.

fields.name: checkouts
docs: Checkouts admitted so far: the next one must carry this number.

types.name: Draw
docs: A Draw Proof: anyone can check `randomness` against ORAO's oracle keys and recompute the rest (ADR-0005).

types.name: Mode
docs: Normal is a Standard Purchase; Lucky(n) plays Game Version n.

fields.name: final_bps
docs: Final Price as a share of the Lucky Amount, e.g. 5_000 = pays half.
